messages.subject: CPD seminar: Developments in patent licensing - 27 November
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear colleagues,

The IP group is hosting a lunchtime CPD seminar on recent developments in patent and technology licensing on 27 November, 12:30-13:30, Room 4. Sandwiches provided. RSVP to Learning.

WC Learning & Development
